en.text: Moreover Elihu answered,

zhSimplified.text: 以利户又说：

zhTraditional.text: 以利戶又說：

en.text: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 你们智慧人要听我的话； 有知识的人要留心听我说。

zhTraditional.text: 你們智慧人要聽我的話； 有知識的人要留心聽我說。

en.text: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耳朵试验话语， 好像上膛尝食物。

zhTraditional.text: 因為耳朵試驗話語， 好像上膛嘗食物。

en.text: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

zhSimplified.text: 我们当选择何为是， 彼此知道何为善。

zhTraditional.text: 我們當選擇何為是， 彼此知道何為善。

en.text: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

zhSimplified.text: 约伯曾说：我是公义， 神夺去我的理；

zhTraditional.text: 約伯曾說：我是公義， 上帝奪去我的理；

en.text: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

zhSimplified.text: 我虽有理，还算为说谎言的； 我虽无过，受的伤还不能医治。

zhTraditional.text: 我雖有理，還算為說謊言的； 我雖無過，受的傷還不能醫治。

en.text: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

zhSimplified.text: 谁像约伯， 喝讥诮如同喝水呢？

zhTraditional.text: 誰像約伯， 喝譏誚如同喝水呢？

en.text: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

zhSimplified.text: 他与作孽的结伴， 和恶人同行。

zhTraditional.text: 他與作孽的結伴， 和惡人同行。

en.text: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

zhSimplified.text: 他说：人以 神为乐， 总是无益。

zhTraditional.text: 他說：人以上帝為樂， 總是無益。

en.text: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，你们明理的人要听我的话。 神断不致行恶； 全能者断不致作孽。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，你們明理的人要聽我的話。 上帝斷不致行惡； 全能者斷不致作孽。

en.text: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

zhSimplified.text: 他必按人所做的报应人， 使各人照所行的得报。

zhTraditional.text: 他必按人所做的報應人， 使各人照所行的得報。

en.text: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

zhSimplified.text: 神必不作恶； 全能者也不偏离公平。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝必不作惡； 全能者也不偏離公平。

en.text: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

zhSimplified.text: 谁派他治理地， 安定全世界呢？

zhTraditional.text: 誰派他治理地， 安定全世界呢？

en.text: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

zhSimplified.text: 他若专心为己， 将灵和气收归自己，

zhTraditional.text: 他若專心為己， 將靈和氣收歸自己，

en.text: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

zhSimplified.text: 凡有血气的就必一同死亡； 世人必仍归尘土。

zhTraditional.text: 凡有血氣的就必一同死亡； 世人必仍歸塵土。

en.text: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

zhSimplified.text: 你若明理，就当听我的话， 留心听我言语的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 你若明理，就當聽我的話， 留心聽我言語的聲音。

en.text: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

zhSimplified.text: 难道恨恶公平的可以掌权吗？ 那有公义的、有大能的，岂可定他有罪吗？

zhTraditional.text: 難道恨惡公平的可以掌權嗎？ 那有公義的、有大能的，豈可定他有罪嗎？

en.text: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

zhSimplified.text: 他对君王说：你是鄙陋的； 对贵臣说：你是邪恶的。

zhTraditional.text: 他對君王說：你是鄙陋的； 對貴臣說：你是邪惡的。

en.text: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

zhSimplified.text: 他待王子不徇情面， 也不看重富足的过于贫穷的， 因为都是他手所造。

zhTraditional.text: 他待王子不徇情面， 也不看重富足的過於貧窮的， 因為都是他手所造。

en.text: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

zhSimplified.text: 在转眼之间，半夜之中， 他们就死亡。 百姓被震动而去世； 有权力的被夺去非借人手。

zhTraditional.text: 在轉眼之間，半夜之中， 他們就死亡。 百姓被震動而去世； 有權力的被奪去非借人手。

en.text: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

zhSimplified.text: 神注目观看人的道路， 看明人的脚步。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝注目觀看人的道路， 看明人的腳步。

en.text: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 没有黑暗、阴翳能给作孽的藏身。

zhTraditional.text: 沒有黑暗、陰翳能給作孽的藏身。

en.text: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 神审判人，不必使人到他面前再三鉴察。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝審判人，不必使人到他面前再三鑒察。

en.text: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

zhSimplified.text: 他用难测之法打破有能力的人， 设立别人代替他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他用難測之法打破有能力的人， 設立別人代替他們。

en.text: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

zhSimplified.text: 他原知道他们的行为， 使他们在夜间倾倒灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 他原知道他們的行為， 使他們在夜間傾倒滅亡。

en.text: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

zhSimplified.text: 他在众人眼前击打他们， 如同击打恶人一样。

zhTraditional.text: 他在眾人眼前擊打他們， 如同擊打惡人一樣。

en.text: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们偏行不跟从他， 也不留心他的道，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們偏行不跟從他， 也不留心他的道，

en.text: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

zhSimplified.text: 甚至使贫穷人的哀声达到他那里； 他也听了困苦人的哀声。

zhTraditional.text: 甚至使貧窮人的哀聲達到他那裏； 他也聽了困苦人的哀聲。

en.text: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

zhSimplified.text: 他使人安静，谁能扰乱呢？ 他掩面，谁能见他呢？ 无论待一国或一人都是如此—

zhTraditional.text: 他使人安靜，誰能擾亂呢？ 他掩面，誰能見他呢？ 無論待一國或一人都是如此－

en.text: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

zhSimplified.text: 使不虔敬的人不得作王， 免得有人牢笼百姓。

zhTraditional.text: 使不虔敬的人不得作王， 免得有人牢籠百姓。

en.text: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

zhSimplified.text: 有谁对 神说： 我受了责罚，不再犯罪；

zhTraditional.text: 有誰對上帝說： 我受了責罰，不再犯罪；

en.text: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

zhSimplified.text: 我所看不明的，求你指教我； 我若作了孽，必不再作？

zhTraditional.text: 我所看不明的，求你指教我； 我若作了孽，必不再作？

en.text: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

zhSimplified.text: 他施行报应， 岂要随你的心愿、叫你推辞不受吗？ 选定的是你，不是我。 你所知道的只管说吧！

zhTraditional.text: 他施行報應， 豈要隨你的心願、叫你推辭不受嗎？ 選定的是你，不是我。 你所知道的只管說吧！

en.text: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

zhSimplified.text: 明理的人和听我话的智慧人必对我说：

zhTraditional.text: 明理的人和聽我話的智慧人必對我說：

en.text: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

zhSimplified.text: 约伯说话没有知识， 言语中毫无智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 約伯說話沒有知識， 言語中毫無智慧。

en.text: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

zhSimplified.text: 愿约伯被试验到底， 因他回答像恶人一样。

zhTraditional.text: 願約伯被試驗到底， 因他回答像惡人一樣。

en.text: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

zhSimplified.text: 他在罪上又加悖逆； 在我们中间拍手， 用许多言语轻慢 神。

zhTraditional.text: 他在罪上又加悖逆； 在我們中間拍手， 用許多言語輕慢上帝。
